components.name: Panel
components.description: White hairline-bordered container with a title; the only container level.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--panel, #fff); border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 4px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); width: 320px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #1d1d1f; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px 4px; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-empty { margin: 0; padding: 8px 16px 16px; color: #6e6e73; font-size: 0.9375rem; }

components.name: Board header and row
components.description: Column-header row over hairline rows; time right-aligned. Rows are shown only in later items.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-board { width: 420px; background: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #1d1d1f; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-head, .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4rem 1fr 5.5rem 4.5rem; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; } .ds-head { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6e6e73; border-top: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-num { text-align: right; } .ds-row { font-size: 1.0625rem; padding-block: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-row:active { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04); } .ds-selected { background: rgb(0 113 227 / 0.08); } .ds-time { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Dot plus text label; the only place green, amber and red appear.
components.html: Green Amber Red
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 0.75rem -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-ok { color: #1a7f3c; background: #e6f4ea; } .ds-warn { color: #8a5a00; background: #fff3d6; } .ds-crit { color: #c4201a; background: #fde8e7; }

components.name: Button
components.description: Quiet white pill; press feedback on press.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 600 0.8125rem/1 -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #1d1d1f; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 100ms ease-out, background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f0f0f2; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (selected row)
components.description: Blue only when its row is selected; otherwise renders as the quiet Button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 600 0.8125rem/1 -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #0071e3; border-radius: 999px; background: #0071e3; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 100ms ease-out, background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0077ed; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: API health readout in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); font: 0.8125rem -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #515154; }

narrative.overview: Every convoy and alert is a departure: a timed row with a place, a status and a time you can trust. The system is a station departures board and railway reservation chart set in light Apple-clean material: a pale grey ground, white panels, the platform UI font, tabular numerals, and one-pixel hairlines between rows. It is built for a planner or judge in a command room on a laptop or projector at 1280x720 or wider, who scans for the first red row, selects it, and approves the departure. It is deliberately not a white-card analytics dashboard: no KPI tiles, no boxes inside boxes. Rows, chips and the time column are defined in CSS but shown only in later items; the Phase 6 item 1 shell renders the top bar, pill, panels, board headers and empty states.
keyCharacteristics: Light, flat, hairline-ruled; depth is one faint ambient shadow on panels only.
Blue means selection and nothing else; status colour lives only in labelled chips.
Numbers are tabular and the running time sits right-aligned hard against the margin.
One system font stack; hierarchy by size and weight on a fixed rem scale.

rules.name: The Blue Is Selection Rule
rules.body: Blue marks the selected row, focus, and the one primary action of the selected row. It is never decoration, never a status.

rules.name: The Labelled Status Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only inside a chip that carries a text label. Never colour alone, never as a row fill, border or text colour elsewhere.

rules.name: The Right-Margin Time Rule
rules.body: The last numeric column is right-aligned and set in the Time style.

rules.name: The Hairline Only Rule
rules.body: Rows are separated by a single 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08) rule; the last row has none. No nested cards.

dos: Do keep a column-header row on every board and share its --grid template with the rows.
Do right-align the running-time column and keep numerals tabular.
Do pair every status colour with a text label inside a chip.
Do give press feedback on press, with transitions off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use the token spacing and rem type scales.
donts: Don't use blue for anything but selection, focus and the selected row's primary action.
Don't use green, amber or red outside labelled chips.
Don't nest boxes or cards inside panels, or add KPI tiles.
Don't introduce a webfont or a second shadow style.
